```python
from picogrid_ecn_client import TLSConfig
```

Configure TLS transport and optional custom certificate authority material.

```python
TLSConfig(
    *,
    enabled: bool = True,
    verify: bool = True,
    ca_certificate: CertificateMaterial | None = None,
)
```

[Source · auth.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/auth.py#L119)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | bool | no | True | — | Whether TLS transport is enabled; defaults to true. |
| verify | bool | no | True | — | Whether TLS peer certificates are verified; defaults to true. |
| ca_certificate | CertificateMaterial \| None | no | None | — | Optional custom certificate-authority material; requires TLS. |
